title: ロボットセンシング
subtitle: Measurement Engineering
teachers:
ITO Kouhei
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
(1) Learn the technology for physical and chemical sensors.
(2) Learn sensor systems.
(3) Learn how to process signals from acquired sensor output.
advice: This is a course on measurement engineering for robots. Students will learn how to select and use sensors.
books: Foundation of Sensor and Practical Use of Electic Circuit

activityGoals.body: To be able to explain that various sensors are based on physical principles.
To be able to explain simple circuits of analog circuits, especially operational amplifiers.
To be able to explain about bridge circuits ．
To be able to explain simple digital circuits
To be able to explain in general what kind of sensors are equivalent to the five senses of human beings.

achievementLevels.standard:

Explain where sensors are used in robots.
